violated_contract: An asynchronous request whose error is handled by its caller must not emit an additional unhandled error through a discarded cleanup future. Request cleanup must complete on the same future observed by callers, including callers sharing a deduplicated request.
canonical_prevention: Return and share the future that includes cleanup, or await the operation inside try/finally and await asynchronous cleanup there. Exercise the production request path with failing transports and capture uncaught zone errors; also prove successful completion, pending-request eviction, deduplication and resource cancellation.
